subject: Approval request: LuminaCare milestone invoicing & extended terms
messages:
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@luminacare.health>
To: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Request: milestone invoicing schedule + Net-90 terms

Hi Marcus / Grace,

Thanks again for the product overview last week. Procurement here runs on a quarterly payment cycle tied to our fiscal close, so we need two accommodations to move forward quickly:

- Milestone-triggered invoicing (4 invoices aligned to delivery milestones)
- Net-90 payment terms from invoice date (standard Net-30 causes internal cashflow friction)

I've attached our draft PO for reference (LuminaCare_PO.pdf). If Redwood can accept milestone invoices on Net-90 and provide a short addendum to the MSA, procurement can issue a PO by the end of the month.

Can you confirm whether this requires executive approval or a deal-desk exception? We can be flexible on an initial deposit or a small processing fee if that helps mitigate risk.

Best,
Aisha Malik
Procurement Manager
LuminaCare

--
Attachment: LuminaCare_PO.pdf (application/pdf, 72KB)

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@luminacare.health>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: milestone invoicing schedule + Net-90 terms

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear ask and the PO. Looping in Grace (finance) and Aditya (VP Sales) to scope risk and confirm whether we can approve Net-90 for LuminaCare.

High-level thoughts for internal folks:
- Customer size and strategic fit look good; deal is forecasted in the mid-six figures.
- Proposed structure: 4 milestone invoices aligned to delivery/enablement, with the first invoice due on contract signature (we can request a partial upfront payment).
- Primary concern: extended receivables impact and credit exposure; need credit check and approval for net-90.

Aisha — can you confirm expected payment owner (AP vs a third-party payor) and whether LuminaCare can provide a PO + ACH details once we agree? If an interim deposit eases approval, please indicate what you can commit to.

Grace / Aditya — see attached MAP (MAP-LuminaCare-v2.docx) for proposed milestone dates and deliverables. Recommend a credit check and a conditional approval note for the contract addendum if finance signs off.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

--
Attachment: MAP-LuminaCare-v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 48KB)

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: milestone invoicing schedule + Net-90 terms

Marcus / Aditya — did a quick review of LuminaCare and ran the vendor credit check (see stubbed report: credit-check.pdf). Summary:

- Entity: LuminaCare (private, moderate AR days historically)
- Risk: medium — larger organizations with similar profiles have been approved at Net-60; Net-90 is higher than our standard tolerance.
- Suggested path: conditional approval with controls:
  1) Require 20% upfront on signature (applied to first milestone)
  2) Limit outstanding exposure — cap receivables at the first two milestone invoices before releasing additional work
  3) Require PO + ACH details and contact in AP for collections

If Sales wants to pursue Net-90, Finance will escalate to Executive Deal Desk for sign-off. Alternatively we can offer Net-60 or quarterly invoicing with standard Net-30 payment terms to reduce exposure.

I'll flag this to Treasury for monitoring if it moves forward.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Revenue Operations (Finance Liaison), Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

--
Attachment: credit-check.pdf (application/pdf, 24KB)

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: milestone invoicing schedule + Net-90 terms

Team — after reviewing the summary and projected ARR impact, I'm willing to approve Net-90 on a conditional basis for LuminaCare. Conditions to document in the contract addendum and deal record: 

- 20% non-refundable deposit due at signature (applies to milestone 1)
- Maximum outstanding receivable limited to two milestone invoices at any time; Redwood can pause work if cap is exceeded
- PO and ACH info to be provided within 5 business days of signature
- Legal to add an addendum that explicitly notes Net-90 exception and escalation path for late payments (collection fees + interest)

Marcus — please confirm you will ask the customer for the deposit and collect AP contact details. Grace — please create the finance exception record and add Treasury monitoring. Legal: we will need a simple addendum; I suggest standard language reused from prior Net-90 exceptions.

Aisha — we can accept the terms above and are happy to move forward if LuminaCare agrees. Please confirm the deposit and PO timing.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
VP, Sales — Enterprise Accounts, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
